latest_release.body:
# Highlighted changes

- Add Orderbook websocket support.
- Fully Decouple bot from RPC messaging for more reliable bot loop execution.
- Parameter values are now kept per strategy instance. Access them through `self.<param>.value`, not through the class.
- Armv7 (raspberry 32bit)  image updated to python 3.13.
- Dropped support for python 3.11.
- Support changing strategy parameters from Backtesting UI (`webserver` mode only).
- FreqUI will now use the backtested strategy to plot in backtest mode (`webserver` mode only).
- `backtesting-show --export-params` now writes the parameters from a backtest back to the strategy.
- Improved efficiency for `AgeFilter` doing fewer calls for validated pairs.

## Sponsor

You can sponsor the work on freqtrade via the following links:

- froggleston (FTUI) https://github.com/sponsors/froggleston/
- robcaulk (freqAI) https://github.com/sponsors/robcaulk/
- xmatthias (freqtrade and freqUI): https://github.com/sponsors/xmatthias/

## New Contributors
* @Siegelth made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13657
* @Jhacarreiro made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13662
* @Bortlesboat made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13678
* @lizimu1013 made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13697
* @louisvikk6-max made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13681
* @M1ch43lV made their first contribution in https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/pull/13719

## How to update

As always, you can update your bot using one of the following commands:

### docker-compose

```bash
docker-compose pull
docker-compose up -d
```

### Installation via setup script

``` bash
# Deactivate venv and run 
./setup.sh --update
```

### Plain native installation

``` bash
git pull
pip install -U -r requirements.txt
```
